description: Statement summaries from the UK government modern slavery statement registry — organisation, Companies House number, registry year and statement period, whether it is a group statement and under which parent, turnover band, sectors, how long the organisation has produced statements, the six "statement includes" answers (structure, policies, risk assessment, due diligence, training, goals), the policy, training, audit and grievance tick-boxes, and links to the statement and the registry PDF. By company number with history; refreshed daily. The registry is voluntary, so a company with no row is not thereby non-compliant. Signatory names, contact emails and narrative answers are never ingested. Filters combine with AND; q searches all text fields. Costs 1 credit(s) per call with an API key; without one, a preview of up to 5 rows (30 calls/day).
name: query_uk_modern_slavery_statements
title: UK modern slavery statements (government registry)
